nste01.title: The Question at the Party
nste01.caption: That moment at the party when someone asks if you're seeing anyone. You don't owe a long story: "not right now, and I'm happy" is enough. Then ask about their year.

nste02.title: Decorating for One
nste02.caption: Decorating when it's just you can feel a little pointless. It isn't. You're the one who lives there, so make it cozy for you first.

nste03.title: The Couples Photo
nste03.caption: Ever end up holding the camera because everyone else came as a pair? You're not the extra in the picture. Set the timer and get in the shot.

nste04.title: Soup for Everyone
nste04.caption: Looking after everyone is lovely, until you're eating crackers for dinner. This week, cook for yourself the way you cook for the people you love.

nste05.title: Lights Walk, No Plus-One
nste05.caption: Seeing the lights on your own can feel strange at first. Go for the lights, not the photo. Want a picture? Just ask someone, then return the favour.

nste06.title: The Day Off Plan
nste06.caption: A day off with a 37-step plan isn't really a day off. Rest doesn't need to be finished or checked. Pick one nice thing and let the rest wander.
